scope: Prevent silent loss of a present fourth-corner Z coordinate on DXF SOLID, TRACE and 3DFACE records when both fourth X and Y are absent. No support claim for arbitrary malformed records.
source: Autodesk's SOLID and 3DFACE DXF references identify groups 13/23/33 as the fourth corner and state that a three-corner entity repeats its third corner: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E0C5F04E-D0C5-48F5-AC09-32733E8848F2.htm and https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-747865D5-51F0-45F2-BEFE-9572DBC5B151.htm. The existing reader already rejected fourth X-only and Y-only records. ezdxf 1.4.5's low-level tag compiler represents a 13/23 pair without 33 as a valid two-component point; the local reader preserves its default Z=0 behavior.
problem: Each entity parser tracked whether fourth X and Y appeared but did not track fourth Z. A record containing group 33 alone passed validation; the triangle fallback overwrote its fourth Z with the third corner and published the changed entity. The locally authored pre-fix SOLID test reproduced acceptance.
change: Track group-33 presence locally in each of the three parse loops. Reject a present fourth Z if the fourth X/Y pair is absent; retain existing X/Y pair validation, three-corner fallback, reordered complete components, and omitted zero-Z behavior. This changes no public data member, virtual table, or manually authored object behavior.
validation: libdxfrw_dxf_fourth_corner passes in ASCII and binary for all three entity types: group 33 before and after the third corner, incomplete X/Z and Y/Z, no callback or following LINE on refusal, same-reader retry with a valid triangle, all six complete 13/23/33 permutations, explicit X/Y origin with omitted Z, and manually authored entity output/readback. An invalid manual 3DFACE write preserves the destination and caller state and succeeds on corrected same-writer retry. Drawings are generated in scratch storage; no fixtures are committed.
compatibility: Malformed group-33-only inputs previously published a triangle with that Z discarded; they now report a read error. A source with no fourth-corner groups remains a valid triangle, and an explicit fourth X/Y pair with omitted Z keeps Z=0.
